vulnerability_patterns.description: Before the patch, YCbCr subsampling values from `td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[]` were copied into `sp->h_sampling` and `sp->v_sampling` without rejecting zero, allowing later arithmetic that consumes these fields as divisors or denominator-like scaling factors to execute with zero values. The patch blocks this by validating the fields and returning before any later use.
trigger_conditions: At least one assigned sampling value is zero.
Control would otherwise continue into later YCbCr setup/computation using these sampling fields.
fix_patterns: Add a guard `if( sp->h_sampling == 0 || sp->v_sampling == 0 )` immediately after assignment from metadata.
Emit an error via `TIFFErrorExt(...)` and terminate the path with `return (0);` before later consumption.
Use the guard as a barrier on invalid metadata-derived denominator/state, not merely as logging.

analysis_rationale: The patch adds an early guard immediately after assigning `sp->h_sampling = td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[0];` and `sp->v_sampling = td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[1];` in `libtiff/tif_jpeg.c`, and aborts with `TIFFErrorExt(...); return (0);` when either value is zero. This strongly indicates the old path continued using these sampling fields as divisors or in divisor-derived calculations later in the same setup path. The fix shape is a classic precondition barrier on values loaded from metadata before subsequent computation.
